support.title: Support the Community
support.subtitle: The Congo Developer Club is a non-profit initiative. Your support allows us to organize more events, mentor young developers, and build tomorrow's tech ecosystem.
support.donate_desc: Support our actions with a one-time or regular financial contribution. Every amount helps fund our servers, meetups, or equipment.
support.sponsor_desc: Associate your company with DRC's leading developer club. Sponsor our events and hackathons to gain visibility among top talents.
support.volunteer_desc: Have time or skills to offer? Help us with organization, communication, or become a mentor for younger developers.
support.why_desc: Tech is a true social and economic elevator for our country. By supporting CDC, you directly participate in the emergence of a new generation of technical leaders. You make a digital future 'Made in Congo' possible.
